en: Color postcard view of a historic cityscape dominated by a large Ottoman mosque with a central dome and four tall, slender minarets. The mosque rises above dense low-rise buildings with red-tiled roofs and a few neoclassical-style structures in the foreground. The sky is clear blue. At the top left is French text and at the top right Ottoman Turkish script. A small website watermark appears at the bottom.
